purpose: Cov7 -- 30 additional stratum-D reads, to tighten the residual-coverage interval (MEAS-2).
method: attach_meta.jsonl was never committed, so the A/B/C/D strata were re-derived from live Grants.gov attachment metadata for all 815 records carrying attachments. The reconstruction reproduces the committed frame to within 4 records (A 214/215, B 89/90, C 26/27, D 482/483) and reproduces the survey's D-html count exactly (363).

frame.definition: stratum D = a record with at least one non-PDF attachment
frame.exclusion_basis: every opportunity id named in the committed census, survey, taxonomy, plan and inspection documents
frame.exclusion_limitation: the taxonomy's 50-record sample is not enumerated in any committed artifact, so records it drew but never named by id could not be excluded. 19 of the drawn-from pool were excludable by name.

combined_pooled.caveat: Cov7 deliberately over-sampled D-other, so the pooled rate is not a simple random sample of D

measurement.bookkeeping_discrepancy: the plan's Cov7 row says stratum D has 12 reads; the taxonomy's own sample table sums to 13 (survey 7 + taxonomy 6). The committed 4.3 rate table says 12, and 12 is used here. The difference moves no conclusion.

regressions.note: No record in the sample produced a span, so Cov4 was never invoked and Cov6's publication predicate was never reached. This sample cannot exercise either gate; it also cannot have been harmed by one.
